title: Address Residences Al Marjan Island
about:
Explore Phase 2 of Address Residences Al Marjan Island, Convieniently situated next to the upcoming Wynn Casino Resort. Experience the epitome of luxury living at Emaar Address Residences Al Marjan Island, a distinguished development brought to you by Address Hotels + Resorts, situated in the heart of the prestigious Al Marjan Island. These luxury apartments at RAK offer unparalleled access to the Arabian Sea and are conveniently located near the island's dynamic urban landscape. Address Residences Apartments are designed with sophistication and style, featuring 1- to 2-bedroom units with expansive balconies that provide spectacular views of the sea and the bustling community below.

Families or individuals seeking more expansive living spaces will find the 3-bedroom townhouses at Address Residences Al Marjan Island, offering large, well-appointed layouts with exceptional vistas. This serene oasis blends the majestic UAE skyline with the azure waters of the Arabian Sea, ensuring every modern comfort is just a step away. Explore the diverse range of apartments for sale in Address Residences and step into a life of refined luxury.

characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Branded Homes: Part of the prestigious Address Hotels + Resorts portfolio, these luxury apartments at RAK offer unparalleled service and lifestyle.
  • Natural Scenery: Enjoy a serene backdrop along the Arabian Sea, enhancing the allure of these apartments for sale in Address Residences.
  • Beachfront Luxury: Over 600 meters of beachfront offers expansive sea and island views, defining luxury living at its finest.
  • Urban Convenience: Proximity to Al Marjan Island's vibrant town center ensures easy access to urban amenities.
  • Hotel Benefits: Residents enjoy privacy blended with resort-style luxury, typical of Emaar's commitment to high standards.
  • Year-Round Haven: The ideal climate for enjoying the natural beauty and outdoor activities all year round.

Discover coastal luxury at Address Residences Al Marjan Island, part of Emaar's prestigious Address Residences Apartments in RAK. Nestled next to the upcoming Wynn Casino resort, this prime waterfront location offers direct beach access and proximity to Marjan Island's vibrant urban hub. Explore luxury apartments for sale, surrounded by family-friendly hotels, serene resorts, and elegant beachside residences, providing an idyllic escape amidst the endless scenic beauty of Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah.

  • 15 minutes From Ras Al Khaimah International Airport
  • 10 minutes From Al Hamra Village
  • 33 minutes From Downtown Ras Al Khaimah
  • 45 minutes From Dubai International Airport
